<div class="card-body">
'''Hypo''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハイポ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＩＴ－Ｏに配備する。自分の支配フェイズに捕虜と同じ位置にあれば、どちらかの効果を選ぶ。1：敵に、敵の手札について1つだけ、“はい”か“いいえ”で答えられる質問をする。敵は正直に答えるか、回答を拒否して1フォースを失う。2：フォース消耗を＋1する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hypo-PSA-97065196.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">バーヴォ6のような自白剤には、尋問への抵抗力を弱める効果がある。巨大な注射針を相手に向ける心理的効果は抜群で、尋問の効率も上がる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hypo.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on IT-O. If at the same location as a captive during your control phase, choose one effect. Ask your opponent one yes-or-no question about their hand. They must answer truthfully or refuse and lose 1 Force. Alternatively, increase the Force drain by 1.

'''Lore:'''
Truth drugs such as Bavo Six weaken resistance to questioning. Pointing an enormous needle at the subject adds psychological pressure and makes the interrogation more effective.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The original English strip reads Device.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hypo]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
